input.quote: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
input.rationale: Section 15.3 b) is the only monetary cap in the Base Agreement. It is mutual and 15.3 a) contains a mutual waiver of lost profits, consequential, punitive and incidental damages, but the cap fails the fallback on two material terms. The basis — 3% of the bill-of-materials value of all Products delivered over the whole term — is a small fraction of the charges IBM pays MSL and sits below six months' fees (walk-away). There are also no carve-outs: MSL's indemnity in 15.1, the confidentiality obligations in 13.2 and the AECI, gross negligence and willful misconduct all sit inside the cap with no super-cap. The redline changes only the cap basis to fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim or USD 1,000,000 if greater, and adds one carve-out sentence with the payment-obligations statement. The one-sided $25,000 limit in the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement §15 benefits IBM and is untouched.

ops.oldText: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
ops.newText: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to the greater of the value of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.

ops.text: c) This limitation does not apply to either Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, or infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. Customer's payment obligations, being IBM's obligation to pay all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages for purposes of this limitation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We changed only the cap basis: 3% of bill-of-materials value sits far below our position of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, or USD 1,000,000 if greater. The added sentence keeps indemnities, confidentiality/data protection/security breaches, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirms Customer's payment obligations are not damages.
proposal.summary: Reset the mutual cap basis to the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 and add one carve-out sentence.
